items.name: Princely Sea-Steel Blade
items.description:
Sea-Steel is a rare, magically hardened form of deep-sea coral that is nearly indistinguishable from polished steel, save for its faint iridescent sheen that shifts between blue-green and storm-gray under certain light. Found only in deep ocean trenches, it is harvested and shaped by sahuagin weapon forgers, who infuse it with abyssal salts and elemental water magic to make it as strong as steel.

items.name: Exile
items.description:
Exile was the final weapon of Sir Drogmir Ironshade, a dwarven knight with bloodied honor and a loyalty to lords more interested in war than truth. After delivering the fatal blow to a royal kin-slayer, Drogmir vanished from the high halls of the surface kingdoms—some say banished, others say exiled by his own choosing when his usefulness was outlived.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +2
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Krakencoil of Strength +2
items.description: This belt is fashioned from the sinew-woven hide of a deep kraken, stained black with abyssal ink and set with barnacled bronze buckles. It smells faintly of salt and storm. Wearing it grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength.

items.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Potion of Heroism
items.description: This spell imbues a single creature with great bravery and morale in battle. The target gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.

items.name: Potion of Barkskin
items.description:
Barkskin toughens a creature's skin. The effect grants a +2 enhancement bonus to the creature's existing natural armor bonus. This enhancement bonus increases by 1 for every three caster levels above 3rd, to a maximum of +5 at 12th level.
The enhancement bonus provided by barkskin stacks with the target's natural armor bonus, but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor. A creature without natural armor has an effective natural armor bonus of +0.

items.name: Trail Rations, Dwarven
items.description: Dwarven trail rations consist of smoked sausages and salted meat, rounded out with hard biscuits and dried vegetables. If you are a dwarf who subsists on nothing but these rations for at least 1 week, you can hustle or make a forced march for an additional hour without ill effects, but cannot do both in the same day. This benefit lasts until you eat a meal other than the rations or go for a full day without eating a day's worth.
